setup: The number [[n]] is built from digits, and each digit's value depends on where it sits.

steps.say: The digit in the [[label]] place of [[n]] is [[digit]]. A digit on its own is not a value — its value is the digit times the size of its place.
The [[label]] place is worth [[place_unit]] each: one unit in that place is a whole ten.

answer: The [[label]] digit is [[digit]], and it is worth [[value]].
